producer: FileSystemCAS.verify_all_signatures(verifier, artifact_ids=required_refs, pending_window=..., cancel_event=..., deadline=<absolute monotonic>) -> BulkVerificationReport
consumer_predicate: report.require_complete_valid(required_refs) -> None or raises ValueError. Required refs come from actual existing declared publication set, including selected profile/kind/media identity. Consume the fresh canonical in-process report, not externally provided JSON or counters.
contract_fields: every details row artifact_id + exact artifact_ref + SignatureVerificationStatus
purpose: Structural full valid signature confirmation prerequisite only where the existing owner already requires all confirmations; this API does not appoint authority, a trust policy, population or public publisher.

positive_input.input: Three real CAS objects, fresh Ed25519 key+trusted verifier, exact persisted signatures; all3 distinct exact refs require_complete_valid succeeds.

negative_inputs.input: Same real3 signed objects, actually corrupt second blob; report has2VALID1ERROR and completeness refuses. No publication may occur under an existing all-confirmations law.
Same3, cancel after actual first signature verification, pending1; retain actual finished row but stateaborted, completeness refuses.
Keep validcounter3 and report metadata but remove actual final per-item row; predicate refuses. Callerboolean/reportcount is insufficient.
Same blob default+selected have distinct required view identities; duplicate/missing/default-substitution confirmations refuse.

existing_consumers.bulk_signature: Actual --all cryptoCLI retains unsigned/trust options and refuses aborted state; it is not publication.
existing_consumers.integrity_publisher: Actual CASimport consumes TransferVerificationBatch.require_complete_valid against all measured staged intake before publisher. This is byte/manifest integrity, not signature trust admission.
existing_consumers.source_observation: At441 repository source call sites of verify_all_signatures are the CAS canonical producer/adapter and CLI; require_complete_valid signature consumer is absent from A publication paths. A signature custody monitor is advisory and explicitly supplied population, not appointed all-confirmations publisher.

required_owner_work: A/G chooses and integrates actual current appointed all-confirmations publication consumer, supplies exact required population and existing trust/identity settings, invokes fresh producer+predicate before durable publication under existing owner fences, and runs actual no-publication missing/local-error/aborted negatives. No A source edited by B.
boundaries: Report is a fresh local verifier result, not serialized proof or permission token.
A owns current authorization, trust/identity law, population and publication time fences. No global snapshot/time or authority claim comes from batch complete.
Unsigned/untrusted rows remain allowed by legacy .ok behavior but never satisfy require_complete_valid; this does not retroactively mandate all-signature policy.
Incomplete callbacks/iterator can outlive a deadline; explicit aborted output cannot authorize publication.
